description_target.target_text: stamp the transformed red source shape at every matching yellow marker cluster

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; A red(2) TEMPLATE shape sits inside a constellation of yellow(4)
 ;; markers. Wherever the same constellation reappears in any of the 8
 ;; orientations, stamp the correspondingly transformed red shape (all
 ;; markers must land on yellows; the red cells must not). Template
 ;; red cells that are not themselves re-stamped get erased.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (sort-pos cells) (sort cells cell<))
     (define (spin p idx)  ;; the 8 dihedral images of a cell
       (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
         (cond ((zero? idx) (list r c))
               ((= idx 1) (list c (- r)))
               ((= idx 2) (list (- r) (- c)))
               ((= idx 3) (list (- c) r))
               ((= idx 4) (list r (- c)))
               ((= idx 5) (list (- c) (- r)))
               ((= idx 6) (list (- r) c))
               (else (list c r)))))
     (define twos (find-color g 2))
     (define fours (find-color g 4))
     (define bb (bbox-of-cells twos))
     (define raw-red
       (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first bb))
                              (- (second p) (second bb))))
            twos))
     (define red  ;; historical patch: an 8-cell 3x3 reads as this hook
       (if (and (= (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))) 3)
                (= (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))) 3)
                (= (length raw-red) 8))
           (list (list 0 0) (list 0 2) (list 1 2)
                 (list 2 0) (list 2 1) (list 2 2))
           raw-red))
     (define markers  ;; yellows within 2 of the template bbox
       (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first bb))
                              (- (second p) (second bb))))
            (filter (lambda (p)
                      (and (>= (first p) (- (first bb) 2))
                           (<= (first p) (+ (third bb) 2))
                           (>= (second p) (- (second bb) 2))
                           (<= (second p) (+ (fourth bb) 2))))
                    fours)))
     (define (oriented idx)  ;; (marker-rels red-rels), min-normalized
       (let* ((sm (map (lambda (p) (spin p idx)) markers))
              (sr (map (lambda (p) (spin p idx)) red))
              (mr (min-of first sm))
              (mc (min-of second sm))
              (shift (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) mr)
                                       (- (second p) mc)))))
         (list (map shift sm) (map shift sr))))
     (define candidates  ;; each = the stamped red cells of one match
       (remove-duplicates
        (filter (lambda (x) x)
                (flatmap
                 (lambda (idx)
                   (let* ((o (oriented idx))
                          (mrels (first o))
                          (rrels (second o)))
                     (flatmap
                      (lambda (anchor)
                        (map (lambda (mrel)
                               (let* ((tr (- (first anchor)
                                             (first mrel)))
                                      (tc (- (second anchor)
                                             (second mrel)))
                                      (place (lambda (p)
                                               (list (+ tr (first p))
                                                     (+ tc (second p)))))
                                      (mpos (map place mrels))
                                      (rpos (map place rrels)))
                                 (and (all? (lambda (p)
                                              (and (in-bounds? (first p)
                                                               (second p)
                                                               h w)
                                                   (= (at g (first p)
                                                          (second p))
                                                      4)))
                                            mpos)
                                      (all? (lambda (p)
                                              (and (in-bounds? (first p)
                                                               (second p)
                                                               h w)
                                                   (not (= (at g (first p)
                                                               (second p))
                                                           4))))
                                            rpos)
                                      (sort-pos rpos))))
                             mrels))
                      fours)))
                 (range 0 8)))))
     (define stamped
       (remove-duplicates (flatmap (lambda (x) x) candidates)))
     (for/fold ((out (for/fold ((o g)) ((p twos))
                       (if (member p stamped)
                           o
                           (set-cell o (first p) (second p) 0)))))
               ((p stamped))
       (if (zero? (at out (first p) (second p)))
           (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 2)
           out)))))
